panels.title: In one sentence
panels.description:
Containment = 1 - handoffs / engaged, per VA (never across channels), last 30 days against the 30 before (proposed thresholds, n360.settings).

**Source:** n360.v_va_change  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** the 60 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(concat(toString(countIf(containment_30 IS NOT NULL)), if(countIf(containment_30 IS NOT NULL) = 1, ' VA', ' VAs')), ' with handoff data · ',
                      toString(countIf(containment_30 < (SELECT containment_low_pct FROM n360.settings))), ' contain under 50% · ',
                      toString(countIf(containment_down)), ' down 3+ points on the 30 days before · ',
                      toString(countIf(containment_30 IS NULL)), ' without handoff data (not reported)') AS sentence
        FROM n360.v_va_change WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Data
panels.description:
The last day of usage in this load, and the day it was loaded. Amber when the data is more than 2 days old (n360.settings stamp_stale_days): the numbers are the last good night's. Click for Pipeline health.

**Source:** n360.v_freshness (n360.runs: loaded runs only)  
**Filter:** none  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(stamp, if(stale, concat(' · ', toString(days_old), ' days old'), '')) AS stamp FROM n360.v_freshness

panels.title: Containment per VA: last 4 weeks against the 4 before
panels.description:
containment = 1 - handoffs / engaged, per VA, for the 28 days to the data-through day and the 28 before. Change is in percentage points. Each VA on its own: chat and email are never combined. Click a VA to open it.

**Source:** n360.va_day (handoffs from the platform daily aggregate)  
**Filter:** Customer; VAs with handoff data  
**Window:** the 56 days to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer,
               1 - sumIf(d.handoffs, d.day > dt - 28) / sumIf(d.engaged, d.day > dt - 28) AS `Last 4 weeks`,
               1 - sumIf(d.handoffs, d.day <= dt - 28) / sumIf(d.engaged, d.day <= dt - 28) AS `Previous 4 weeks`,
               round(100 * (`Last 4 weeks` - `Previous 4 weeks`), 1) AS `Change (points)`,
               sumIf(d.engaged, d.day > dt - 28) AS `Engaged, last 4 weeks`,
               concat('/d/n360-va?var-account=', v.account, '&var-va=', toString(v.bot_id)) AS drill
        FROM n360.va_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = d.bot_id
        INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = v.account
        CROSS JOIN (SELECT (SELECT toDate(max(window_end)) FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded') AS dt) AS r
        WHERE d.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND d.handoffs IS NOT NULL AND d.day > dt - 56
        GROUP BY v.bot_id, v.account, v.va_name, v.channels, ac.display_name
        HAVING sumIf(d.engaged, d.day > dt - 28) > 0 ORDER BY `Change (points)`

panels.title: VAs without handoff data
panels.description:
VAs whose handoffs are not read (for example the conversation records reader). Their containment is "Not reported yet": never 0% or 100%, and never left out silently.

**Source:** n360.va, n360.va_day  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** all loaded days

targets.rawSql:
SELECT concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS VA, ac.display_name AS Customer, toString(v.consumption_source) AS Reader,
               CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Float64)') AS Containment
        FROM n360.va AS v INNER JOIN n360.account AS ac ON ac.account = v.account
        WHERE v.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND v.bot_id NOT IN (SELECT bot_id FROM n360.va_day WHERE handoffs IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Containment per VA (weekly)
panels.description:
containment = 1 - handoffs / engaged conversations, per VA and week. One line per VA, so channels are never combined. VAs whose handoffs are not read (conversation records reader) are not shown, rather than shown as zero.

**Source:** the platform daily conversation aggregate table (n360.va_day, n360.va)  
**Filter:** Customer; VAs with handoff data; weeks with engaged conversations  
**Window:** dashboard time range, by week (Monday start)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(d.day)) AS time, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS va,
               1 - sum(d.handoffs) / sum(d.engaged) AS containment
        FROM n360.va_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = d.bot_id
        WHERE d.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND d.handoffs IS NOT NULL AND $__dateFilter(d.day)
        GROUP BY time, va HAVING sum(d.engaged) > 0 ORDER BY time
